## Objective
- “Continue where you left off and finish the game.” Complete the existing game into a polished, playable browser game.

## Requirements
- Do not ask clarifying questions; make reasonable assumptions and briefly note them on completion.
- For visual checks, save small JPEG screenshots (viewport ≤1280px wide) and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- The repository already contains an in-progress canvas MOBA, “ASHEN CROWN — Ruins of Veyra”; continue from its existing implementation rather than starting over.

## Work State
### Completed
- Inspected `index.html`, which contains the existing game, UI, controls, hero abilities, battle simulation, and responsive mobile styling.
- Started a local server with `python3 -m http.server 3002`.
- Installed Chromium and opened `http://localhost:3002` in Playwright.
- Saved and inspected `/tmp/opencode/ashen-initial.jpg`; it showed the game’s initial screen.

### Active
- Assess and improve the existing game, then verify gameplay and presentation in-browser.

### Blocked
- Browser console reported one missing-resource error: `Failed to load resource: the server responded with a status of 404 (File not found) @ http://localhost:3002/favicon.ico:0`; no JavaScript errors were reported.

## Next Move
1. Inspect the initial screenshot and the rendered page/UI; start a battle and exercise keyboard, mouse, and/or touch gameplay.
2. Identify and fix gameplay issues or polish gaps in `index.html`, ensuring victory/defeat and redeploy behavior work.
3. Save and inspect a fresh JPEG screenshot (≤1280px viewport); report changes and reasonable assumptions briefly.

## Relevant Files
- `index.html`: Single-file game implementation, styling, and simulation logic.

## Important Context
- Game is playable via WASD/arrow keys, Space to attack, Q for abilities, 1–5 to switch heroes, canvas click to move/focus, and mobile joystick/action buttons.
- Game goal: destroy enemy towers, then the enemy core, before the allied core falls.
- Worktree status was not checked; no edits have been made yet.
